notes.title: Major update: LAN fix, Optimization and more cars
notes.content:
A major update for Long Way is now live. The changes include:


 LAN connection issue fixed: Players can now join LAN sessions.
 Complete overhaul of the animation system and level optimization, resulting in an average FPS increase from 30% to 40%(yes, optimization used to be so terrible).
 Visual bug with noise around shaded objects has been resolved.
 Vehicle behavior reworked, reducing the chances of flipping for certain cars.
 Vehicle repair bug fixed, ensuring repairs now work as intended.
 Ray-traced reflections improved, now showing more objects and offering sharper reflections in Lumen.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44459955/266521ff787d4559be11b52d8375627a817f6591.png

 Added a level for a photo shoot inside the hangar;

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44459955/42201143c20be97deb0ac2bbb07f56747748c2f7.png

 Pickup model fully replaced, and added two new cars.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44459955/efd37609fcd8675a725acdbf2ff78b2e11c2c95f.png



Thanks to everyone who reported bugs and provided feedback.

notes.title: Update on LAN Issues
notes.content:
Dear players,

I recently discovered some issues with the LAN functionality in our game. I understand how important this feature is for many of you, and I want to assure you that I am actively working on a fix.

At the moment, I am addressing these issues on my own, so it may take some time. I appreciate your patience and support and will keep you updated on the progress.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44459955/628607b4c49288e7703e86bcc4b0a72382ba09d6.gif

Thank you to the players who started the discussion; otherwise, I might not have noticed the issue.

notes.title: Major Update for Long Way: Welcome to a New Era!
notes.content:
I am proud to present the biggest update for your favorite game "Long Way"! I have worked hard to transfer the game to the latest Unreal Engine 5 and implement numerous improvements and new features that will delight all players. Here are the main changes you can expect:

Transition to Unreal Engine 5
The game has been updated from UE 4.27 to UE 5, which has significantly improved performance and graphics.

!{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44459955/7150797b8550fc3d0d34b947d78e51dc85198784.png

Completely Redesigned Physics
The entire physics model of the game has been revised and improved to make driving even more realistic and exciting.

!{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44459955/24c45bbfab8d13bbde2018a5cdbef82943fbf662.png

Updated Interface
The game's interface has been completely redesigned to be more intuitive and modern.
You now have a speedometer and tachometer at your disposal, allowing you to more precisely control your speed and engine RPM.

!{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44459955/3ea7417f4e9ffb4fd17727eedfaa434a300127c0.png

New Tuning Options
New wheels and license plate customization have been added.

!{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44459955/2bcf2a156a1d638c0be4d13af893e9245bfe0d50.png

Next-Generation Graphics
Thanks to Lumen ray tracing, the game now looks even more realistic. Lighting and shadows have reached an unprecedented level of detail.

Photo Mode
A photo mode has been introduced, allowing you to capture the most exciting moments in the game with maximum clarity and beauty.

!{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44459955/d4426aa7092310c91233b548b0900b2401abf1ae.png

New and Redesigned Levels
All existing levels have been redesigned, and new levels have been added to offer you even more variety and challenges.

!{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44459955/5cb9c497d1643c30c95da5894d1abac97aad7e04.png

Many New Cars
The car park has been significantly expanded with many new car models that you can test on the tracks.

This update represents a new stage in the development of Long Way, and I am confident that you will be pleased with all the improvements and new features. Thank you for your support and I look forward to your feedback!

!{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44459955/dd8aa9ee02de239b14da7278291884cf3e0e4d04.png

Let's hit the road to new adventures!

notes.title: Winter Update: Meet the Revolution in the Game World!
notes.content:
Discover a whole new level of realism with completely redesigned physics and improved maps. I ported the game to the engine on Unreal Engine 5, providing an amazing visual experience!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44459955/476b0c9224b3d5203b759169b3280ba2b0870f4a.png

With our new update, you will enjoy improved graphics thanks to the ray tracing feature. Every corner of the world will shine with new colors!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44459955/69dfa27f488502b4d3edbbc895a4732970fb2bc6.png

Experience the complete transformation of driving each car thanks to the updated physics!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44459955/061b92260254243790b1674f30ffb82a9d24858e.png

Create your unique footprint on the roads with the new state license plate feature. Your style, your number!
At the moment, only the state license plate of the Republic of Kazakhstan is available.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44459955/ba6ed76db14fdc3076b8038cb523ca48df8a88d6.png

Don't miss the other improvements and surprises I have prepared for you. Stay tuned.
Thank you for your support and I'm sure this update will make your gaming experience even more exciting!
